review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; independent failure evidence from pane %80
review.decision: Preserve the legacy receipt plus both native generations and refuse admission on a mixed hard fault
review.notes: Independent reviewer reproduced both failures at the previous PR head using synthetic HOME and a fake driver. Those regressions define the boundaries here.

cases.description: A legacy late receipt cannot consume a native held slot or its pending replacement
cases.setup: Seed uncertain parked and sending generations, a legacy pending replacement, a valid attempt record with a confirmed late receipt, and an independent wake.
cases.action: Run the native recovery and a drain from a synthetic HOME with a matching receipt.
cases.expected: The two native inodes and pending replacement survive, and the previous receipt stays recoverable. Only the independent wake submits.

cases.description: A soft slot collision cannot hide a hard recovery failure later in the same intent
cases.setup: Seed a valid multi-claim v2 intent with a privately owned conflicting parked generation first, a nonregular park destination in a later member, and a distinct pending wake.
cases.action: Drain with a fake native driver.
cases.expected: The mixed intent retains its evidence, the hard recovery failure prevents all new input, and the independent pending entry remains available after the storage issue is resolved.
